key_insight: Training language models on structured experimental evidence enabled stronger perovskite reasoning and guided a contact-material choice that outperformed the expert-preferred alternative.
engineering_relevance: Evidence-grounded AI can help prioritize perovskite device experiments, with the selected contact delivering 27.05% efficiency and 96.74% efficiency retention after 1,000 hours at 85 °C in dark thermal ageing.
method: Reconstruct expert-calibrated evidence records from 4,035 training articles.
Train OpenPerov to connect experimental strategies, controls and observations with mechanisms.
Refine selected answers using retrieved evidence and experimentally test a self-assembled monolayer choice.
evidence_signal: On the 800-question PSM-Bench, OpenPerov Flash ranked first among 13 closed-book systems; retrieval-assisted OpenPerov Pro increased Scientific Mastery from 87.6 to 89.1.
watch_item: The reported device validation and dark thermal ageing test do not establish broad design generalizability or long-term operational stability under illumination.
paper_title: Evidence-grounded large language models guide perovskite solar cell design and optimization
